tables.heading_context: ## Structural Parallels: Musical Form and Dance Form
rows: Same structure repeating with new content
Check accent matching, phrase alignment, gesture timing, and whether movement merely illustrates sound.
Mickey-mousing can clarify structure or become simplistic literalism.
Analyze musical architecture, counterpoint, rhythm, canon, and plotless spatial design.
Making music visible is not the same as following every beat.
Separate dance, music, design, chance procedure, shared duration, and performance synchronization.
Independence still requires rigorous timing discipline.
Use West African call-response, cueing, polyrhythm, and drummer adaptation to dancer.
Leadership can shift within the performance ecology.
Diagnose tap rhythm, timbre, weight, floor response, syncopation, and ensemble timing.
Percussive dance is music-making as well as movement.
Track compas, palmas, zapateado, guitar, cante, and negotiated lead/follow.
Neither music nor dance is permanently subordinate.
Compare emotional field, structure correspondence, dramaturgy, and performer adaptation.
Sound can organize atmosphere without dictating phrase mechanics.
